title: Guitar Practice Tracker — The Metronome and Drum Patterns
description: The built-in metronome in Guitar Practice: tempo controls and tap tempo, beats per bar and divisions including triplets, drawing your own kick, snare and hi-hat pattern, and sound options.

scenes.text: This video covers the metronome on the Practice tab.
Press Start, or the M key, to start and stop it. Change the tempo by five or by one, type a number, or tap the tempo a few times.
The ladder steps jump straight to a percentage of the exercise's goal tempo, from seventy up to one hundred and ten percent.
Choose the beats per bar and the division: quarter notes, eighths, sixteenths, triplets, and more. It can follow the exercise's subdivision for you.
The grid is your pattern. The primary row plays like a kick drum, the secondary like a snare, and the minor like a hi hat.
Click a square to turn it on or off, or click and drag across the grid to paint several at once. The presets give you a quick starting point.
Under Sounds and options, choose drum sounds or a classic click, set each volume, or load your own sound files.
You can also have the metronome start and stop with the practice timer.
That's the metronome. The tempo ladder has a video of its own. Happy practicing!
